raw.headline: Playback has the highest mean severity among the four areas and should lead next quarter's effort, with billing/support fixes as a close second.
raw.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation

Prioritize Playback next quarter. Playback accounts for {{C059}} complaints with a severity sum of {{C060}} and a mean severity of {{C061}}, the highest mean severity of the four areas. Its top issue, `playback/general`, has {{C016}} complaints and mean severity {{C018}}, and `playback/stops_pausing` adds {{C041}} complaints with mean severity {{C043}}.

## Evidence

Billing/support is the largest in-scope area by severity sum ({{C064}}) with {{C063}} complaints, and its top issue `billing/subscription_entitlement` ranks second overall with {{C006}} complaints. Usability is the largest area by volume ({{C055}} complaints, severity sum {{C056}}), but its mean severity is {{C057}}. Access has the highest mean severity of all ({{C069}}) yet only {{C067}} complaints, and its issue `access/login_failure` has mean severity {{C038}}. Playback reports are concrete: review `40abba11-6cce-4eff-ae74-9ec4579550e0` describes the app closing while songs play, and review `10878c3f-c43e-43cb-86fe-c993b56403cc` describes playback failing at different times.

## Alternatives considered

Usability has the largest volume but a lower mean severity than Playback, so it is a strong second candidate. Its largest issue, `usability/ads`, has {{C011}} complaints and mean severity {{C013}}, and review `ee11e1df-cb73-4c3a-b5e8-7268c7872b01` describes ad interruptions in the free tier. Billing/support has the highest in-scope severity sum and a clear subscription-entitlement problem in `billing/subscription_entitlement`, with {{C008}} mean severity; review `e51bcefb-8071-4e36-9c57-87281443bd29` describes a purchase that was not approved. Access is the smallest area by volume, though its per-complaint severity is the highest, so it is worth monitoring but is not the largest pool of user harm.

Much of the overall volume sits outside the four areas ({{C051}} complaints, share {{C054}}), mostly in `other/general`, which has {{C001}} vague complaints. Those reviews are too general to assign to a product area, so they should be triaged before any reallocation.

## Limitations

Reviews are self-selected public app-store text, not a representative sample. Cancellation language reflects stated intent, not observed churn, and cancellation intent appears in {{C074}} records. The dataset covers {{C071}} completed records, of which {{C072}} are complaint or cancellation records. Unresolved, pending, or quarantined records number {{C073}}, so no records are excluded for that reason. This memo does not estimate revenue impact or causal effects.
